subject: [hw] DONE V32 rev 6: blocking waits are now interruptible (teardown cannot hang); 13149 checks
body:
Rev 6 changes the implementation in a way the daemon needs, plus one real bug fix. Rev 4 (also post-accept) is included below for completeness.

rev 6: every blocking wait -- pthread_join, pthread_mutex_lock/timedlock, pthread_cond_wait/timedwait, sem_wait/timedwait, pthread_rwlock_rdlock/wrlock/timed*, and pthread_once s wait -- now runs in 100 ms slices and returns EINTR when the calling cpu was asked to stop (n2shim_thread_request_stop() or a failing sibling). Reason: before this, a guest thread blocked on a mutex/cond/sem held by a thread that had itself stopped at a stop_request could never wake, so a daemon teardown that joins its guest threads could hang. A guest absolute deadline is preserved: an already-expired deadline still succeeds on an uncontended lock (or returns ETIMEDOUT when contended), a future one is capped by the 100 ms slices. Documented deviation: after pthread_cond_wait returns EINTR the mutex is NOT held if its holder stopped while holding it (the caller is stopping anyway).
The fail_multi test now proves it: the three guest threads blocked in sem_wait stop on their own within one slice, without the driver posting anything.

rev 6 also fixes a bug I found while testing that path under TSan: n2s_slice() returned "expired" without writing its output timespec, so a past deadline handed uninitialised stack to the host timed lock. ASan and -O2 had passed by stack luck; TSan s stack layout turned it into EINVAL. Fixed in n2s_slice(). Also: TSan s pthread_mutex_timedlock ignores the timeout (returns only when the lock is free), so the driver has a --no-timeouts switch used only by the TSan build that relaxes exactly that one guest check; ASan and -O2 check it strictly.

rev 4 (mentioned before, still current): two self-deadlocks fixed (n2s_self() was called while g_thr_lock was held in pthread_once s failure path and in n2shim_thread_note_stop), plus the v32_once_fail test.
rev 3 and 5 were test-only (timed paths; the 512-object limit).

Last line:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v32/run_tests.sh
  N2TEST V32 PASS 13149/13149
  (direct 2390/2390 in all three builds; e2e 10759/10759 ASan+UBSan and -O2, 10730/10730 TSan --no-fault --no-timeouts; no TSan reports.)

R1: the lock-order fix (rev 4) and the interruptible waits (rev 6) are the only implementation changes since your accept. Both are in STATUS.md with the invariant written down ("Lock order" section); re-check if you have time.

Committed b74cb3e (only my files). Open items unchanged: V02 s side of F8, no phone run, not yet linked into n2vcodecd.
